description: [MỚI 2026-09-24] Tổng giá trị NĐTNN mua trong ngày, SUM xuyên mọi mã CK (stock type 1/2/3) cả HOSE lẫn HNX — theo câu lệnh tham khảo BA STT 5 dòng 41. Rẽ nhánh theo src_stm_code: HOSE dùng Execution Value, HNX dùng Execution Price × Execution Volume (Atomic HNX không có Execution Value); lọc NĐTNN Buy Foreign Investor Type Code IN ('10','20') cho cả 2 sàn [SỬA 2026-09-24 thống nhất với Fact Securities Foreign Trading Snapshot — tương đương <> '00' của BA STT 5 trên domain 00/10/20]. JOIN Security Trading Snapshot bản ghi Trading Time mới nhất theo Symbol × Trading Date (HOSE nối symbol, HNX nối ISIN = issue_code). Không phụ thuộc Fact Securities Foreign Trading Snapshot (Nhóm 2). Đơn vị lưu VND; quy đổi Tỷ đồng ở presentation
etl_logic: WITH sts AS (SELECT security_trading_snapshot.symbol, security_trading_snapshot.isin_code, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.symbol, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_time DESC) AS rn FROM security_trading_snapshot WHERE security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt = :etl_date AND security_trading_snapshot.stock_tp_code IN ('1','2','3')) → INNER JOIN sts ON sts.rn = 1 AND sts.trading_dt = securities_trade.trade_dt AND ((securities_trade.src_stm_code = 'ORDERTRADE_TRADE_BOOK_HOSE' AND sts.symbol = securities_trade.security_symbol_code) OR (securities_trade.src_stm_code = 'ORDERTRADE_TRADE_BOOK_HNX' AND sts.isin_code = securities_trade.security_symbol_code)) → SUM(CASE WHEN securities_trade.buy_foreign_investor_tp_code IN ('10','20') THEN CASE WHEN securities_trade.src_stm_code = 'ORDERTRADE_TRADE_BOOK_HNX' THEN securities_trade.execution_price * securities_trade.execution_vol ELSE securities_trade.execution_val END ELSE 0 END) WHERE securities_trade.trade_dt = :etl_date GROUP BY securities_trade.trade_dt
source_attribute: Execution Value / Execution Price / Execution Volume / Buy Foreign Investor Type Code / Source System Code / Stock Type Code / Trading Time
atomic_column: execution_val / execution_price / execution_vol / buy_foreign_investor_tp_code / src_stm_code / stock_tp_code / trading_time
